ops.sql: SELECT o.Object_ID, o.Name, o.Object_Type, o.CreatedDate FROM t_object o WHERE o.Object_Type = 'Artifact' AND o.Name LIKE 'FB nas-0%' ORDER BY o.Object_ID
SELECT o.Object_ID, o.ea_guid, o.Name FROM t_object o WHERE o.Name LIKE 'FBT Nasazeni prvek%' ORDER BY o.Object_ID
SELECT p.Property, p.Value FROM t_objectproperties p WHERE p.Object_ID IN (SELECT Object_ID FROM t_object WHERE Object_Type = 'Artifact' AND Name = 'FB nas-08-low-zapis') ORDER BY p.Property
